subject: Mobile App Project — Collaboration Inquiry
message: Hi Muhammad, I came across your portfolio and I'm genuinely impressed by the Legend TV case study and your work on the Firebase Admin SDK. We're building a similar high-scale product for a Series A fintech startup — a multi-platform expense management tool. We'd love to discuss a engagement. Are you available for a discovery call this week?

subject: Flutter MVP — Urgent Timeline
message: Hey Muhammad — we have a mobile MVP that needs to be done in 8 weeks. I know that's tight but we heard you can rewrite apps in 21 days! The app is a B2B field sales tool — offline-first, with CRM sync and barcode scanning. Budget is flexible for the right developer. Can we jump on a call today or tomorrow?

subject: Flutter Performance Audit
message: Hello, I found you through a recommendation on Twitter/X. Our Flutter e-commerce platform has serious performance issues — excessive jank and frame drops. We're losing customers. I'd love to bring you on for a performance audit and remediation sprint. Our team can handle implementation if you can identify the issues.

subject: Just wanted to say — brilliant portfolio!
message: Muhammad, I'm not reaching out for a project right now — I just spent 20 minutes going through your portfolio site and it's genuinely one of the best developer portfolios I've ever seen. The case study modals, the smooth animations, the clean layout. Really well done. Keep doing what you're doing. — Tom
